subject.title: [Feature]: Add a visible browser panel to the Control UI for login handoff and browser management

question: Should the browser login handoff ship as a core operator panel now, wait for a plugin-owned Control UI entry-point/contribution API, or be folded into the broader browser preview/dashboard tracker?
rationale: The code already has browser control primitives and some generic plugin-tab plumbing, but exposing authenticated browser state in the Control UI requires maintainer choices about UX, scopes, redaction, interactive control, and API ownership.

options.title: Core operator handoff panel
options.body: Build a first-party Control UI browser handoff panel using existing browser.request/profile/tab primitives with operator-scoped access and explicit security review.

options.title: Plugin-owned entry point
options.body: Wait for the plugin Control UI entry-point/contribution API to stabilize, then implement browser handoff as a browser plugin tab or panel.

options.title: Fold into preview tracker
options.body: Treat this as a subcase of the broader browser preview/dashboard work and avoid a narrower login-handoff surface until live preview scope is decided.

recommendation.title: Core operator handoff panel
recommendation.body: Build a first-party Control UI browser handoff panel using existing browser.request/profile/tab primitives with operator-scoped access and explicit security review.

likelyOwner.reason: He already marked this as the canonical handoff surface and has recent relevant UI/browser history.
